Creates a temporary item. It exists only as long as the effect lasts; it is not permanent loot.

Grants resistance to the chosen element. The effect's chance takes part in the defence against that element; it is not a permanent percentage cut of all damage.

Transfers {transfer} between the target and the caster; the exact action depends on the chosen resource.
Places a soul trap on a suitable monster. The soul is captured when it dies if an empty soul gem is at hand; the death alone does not guarantee a capture.
Makes the character invisible. {conceal}
Lets you rise and descend through the air while it lasts. No damage magnitude or separate chance is set.
Creates magical light around the character while it lasts.
On a successful check, prepares a magical lock. It takes effect when you use a suitable door, not at the moment of casting.
On a successful check, prepares a magical opening. You then have to use the door; the result also depends on the lock and the character's level.
Restores health every magic round. The magnitude is rolled anew on every tick; the first round runs at once.
Stops the target from casting spells while the silence lasts. Landing the effect and the target's resistance are checked separately.
Gives a chance to absorb a Destruction effect and get its cost back as mana. Needs free room in the mana pool; the restoration never exceeds the effect's calculated cost.
Gives a chance to reflect an incoming spell. It is a reflection check, not an armor bonus or a damage cut by the stated percentage.
Gives an extra resistance check against an incoming spell. The number is the chance of the check, not a guaranteed damage reduction.
Camouflages the character, making them harder to notice. {conceal}
Hides the character in shadow. How well it works depends on the lighting. {conceal}
Slows a fall and softens its consequences while the effect is active. It gives no footing in the air.
Removes an active paralysis and protects against new ones while it lasts.
Strengthens jumping: 0.6 is added to the take-off speed multiplier. Gives control in the air while it lasts; it is not +60% to the final jump height.
Improves climbing while it lasts. It is a state of enhanced climbing, not a bonus of M to the skill.
Changes the character's form. The workshop does not offer this effect for spells of your own.
Lets you breathe under water while it lasts. It does not restore health or remove other sources of damage.
Lets you walk on the surface of water while it lasts.
On a successful check, calms creatures of the chosen group. Creatures of other groups are unaffected; further aggression may break the peace.
Improves peaceful dealings with the target through a charm check. It does not control where the target goes.
Creates a shield that absorbs M. The shield ends when its pool or its duration runs out; M is not an armor bonus.
Lets you detect {detect} while it lasts. What shows, how far and which objects are decided by the game's detector.
On a successful check, identifies an item. It does not create a new item or change its hidden properties.
Sets an anchor or returns you to the anchor set earlier. The usual teleport bans and the presence of a return point apply.
Lets you understand languages and takes part in peaceful dealings with the matching creatures. Duration and chance are set separately.
Revives a fallen party member at their body with 30% of their maximum health. It is a ready-made spell; the workshop does not offer it.
While the effect is active, the parts of the dungeon map you explore are shared with party members in the same dungeon. The map is not shared between different dungeons.
Deals M damage to the target and restores M health to the caster, up to their maximum. The restoration is for the calculated amount, not for the enemy's remaining health.
Drains the target's stamina and restores the caster's stamina by M × 64 internal units. Each side stays within its own stamina range.

While worn, gives a 50% chance to absorb a Destruction effect. Absorption returns the effect's calculated cost as mana, only if there is room for it.
Mana after = min(maximum mana, current mana + cost of the absorbed effect).
While worn, raises the chosen skill by 15 points. Bonuses of this kind stack.
Skill = base value + 15 × active enchantments for this skill + other modifiers.
Raises maximum mana by 75 while the chosen condition holds: a season, a moon phase or a suitable creature within 18 m.
Maximum mana = usual maximum + 75 for each active enchantment.
It is a bonus to the maximum, not an instant restoration of 75 mana.
Sets the weight of a single item to 0.25 kg. It is a fixed weight, not a 25% weight cut.
Weight of one item
When enchanted, makes the item four times heavier.
New weight = old weight × 4.
While worn, raises carrying capacity by 25% or 50%, depending on the chosen variant.
While worn, raises carrying capacity by {pct}%.
Carrying capacity = base × (1 + the largest bonus of this kind).
Several such bonuses do not add up: the largest one is used.
While worn, improves armor by 5 on the character sheet; the combat armor value drops by 5. Identical sources do not stack.
Armor bonus
In the current client this property gives a negative enchantment cost but does not lower combat protection: the positive penalty of +5 does not pass the native minimum rule.
Combat modifier = min(0, +5) = 0.
While the item is active, your reputation with the chosen group changes by {v}. It is a modifier, not 10 more every round.
On hitting a creature of the chosen group, adds {v} to the damage. These are absolute points, not percentages.
If a creature of the chosen group is within 8 m, the wearer's chance to hit drops by 5 points. A separate armor channel of −5 applies at the same time; its repeats do not stack.
To-hit penalties from several sources add up. The armor channel is not the same as Strengthens Armor.
While worn, restores a base 1 health every 4 magic rounds: always, in sunlight or in darkness — by the chosen variant.
Health after = min(maximum health, health + 1).
World limits on restoration may change the healing you get.
Every 4 magic rounds, repairs one suitable damaged item. Equipped gear comes first, then a wearing equipped item, then the backpack.
Repair of an ordinary item = max(1, round(maximum condition / 50)); a magic item or artifact — 1 point.
The result never exceeds the maximum condition. Unrepairable items are skipped; repairing magic items depends on the allowed mode.
While worn, loses 1 point of condition every 4 magic rounds under the chosen condition: always, in sunlight or in holy places.

On a hit, restores the wearer's health by the hit's damage, up to the maximum. Does not trigger on a protected target.
Every 4 magic rounds, takes 1 health from each suitable enemy within 2.25 m and restores 1 to the wearer for each.
Two variants: draining enemies within 2.25 m every 4 rounds, or healing by the damage dealt on a hit.
When used, takes 16 health from the wearer; on a hit, 8. The time of last use is updated.
If the item has not been used for longer than {span}, takes 1 health every 4 magic rounds. Using it or striking with it restarts the count.
Variants: health loss on use or hit, or 1 every 4 rounds if the item has not been used for a day or a week.
Uses up a filled soul gem with the chosen soul and raises the available enchantment budget by its value. If the item breaks, the bound creature may be released.
Some souls add related properties automatically; they appear in the final list and are removed together with their parent soul.
Casts the chosen ready-made spell when the item is used; costs 10 points of its condition. Target and settings come from the spell itself.
A self-targeted spell applies at once; a directed one is first readied for release.
On a successful hit that deals damage, applies the chosen ready-made spell to the target and costs 10 points of condition. Does not trigger on a protected target.
When equipped, applies the chosen ready-made spell. Its settings come from the game's catalog, not from the workshop's number fields.
Wear in normal play: −1 condition once every 36 magic rounds; while resting, once every 60.

On first equipping: wear = min(the spell's native mana cost, current condition − 1), not below 0. Re-equipping within 6 game hours is free; legendary items do not pay for equipping. Taking it off ends the bound effects.
